body: an epic dark gothic castle on a hilltop at night, towering black stone silhouette with many spired towers, tall arched gate at the base lit with warm amber torchlight from within. A swirling cosmic nebula sky above with a bright spiral moon, deep space-blue and violet clouds, scattered stars. A long cracked stone approach path leading up to the gate, the cracks between the stones glowing with luminous EMERALD-GREEN #00ff9c light (not blue, not pink) like the ground itself is alive with old magic, tall black iron torch braziers with gold-green flame lining both sides of the path at intervals. TURTLE'S NOTE: this is the one realm still lit the old way -- the emerald glow-path is the signature element, the castle should feel ancient, foreboding, and genuinely dangerous, matching a boss-encounter's front door. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, dramatic wide establishing shot, moody atmospheric fog at the base of the hill, no text, no logos, no watermark, no people

a massive dark gothic castle gate, close-up dramatic view, heavy black iron portcullis half-raised, ancient black stone archway carved with faint sacred-geometry engravings that glow a dim EMERALD-GREEN #00ff9c in the deep grooves. Two tall black iron torch braziers flanking the gate with gold-green flame, thick iron chains hanging from the archway (a visual nod to a chains phase of a siege). TURTLE'S NOTE: this is the threshold moment before a boss encounter -- should feel like a real dare to walk through. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render, moody torchlit atmosphere, thick fog pooling at the base, no text, no logos, no watermark, no people
